messages:
eli: Heads-up — ran full MTEB embeddings + rerank after applying float16 quantize to the embedder. MRR for webqa jumped by ~0.09 vs float32. Looks like a quality regression but suspicious pattern (lots of exact-score ties).

sam: can you share the eval config + seed and the rerank runner version? seeds/ordering have bitten us before.

eli: repro: `./tools/eval_runner --suite mteb --task webqa --model m42-embed-qf16 --seed 42 --topk 10`
config snippet:
```
{"rerank": {"metric": "ndcg", "topk": 10, "tie_breaker": "stable"}, "batch_size": 256}
```

maya: quick thought — our rerank runner sorts by score only, relying on tuple-sort stability. If quantization buckets many scores together, the implicit order can flip between runs. That can change MRR/NDCG.

zoe: CI has a flake matching this. rerank-ndcg test failed intermittently 3/20 runs last week. Log excerpt:
```
AssertionError: NDCG@10 mismatch: expected 0.412 got 0.509
Top hits IDs: [a1, b2, c3, ...]
Note: many adjacent scores equal up to 1e-3
```

ci-bot: [rerank-suite] build 2026-11-02T13:42 failed on eng-ml/runner (artifact: https://ci.internal/builds/3412).

sam: sounds like tie handling. The metric contract assumes deterministic ranking for identical scores. We either need a deterministic tiebreaker or explicitly define metrics to average over ties. I prefer making comparator deterministic (score, doc_pop, doc_id).

devex: agree on comparator. Also propose adding a unit test that forces identical float scores by rounding to N decimals to catch regressions. Update docs to state that eval outputs must be deterministic.

eli: I'll prototype a stable comparator: `return (score, -popularity, doc_id)` and add a test that quantizes scores to 3 decimals so ties are reproducible. Pushing a draft PR shortly.

alex: also add a CI regression job that compares float32 vs quantized top-k distributions (histograms + KS test). If KS p-value < 0.01, fail the job and post diagnostic CSVs.

eli: adding to CI matrix under `eng-ml/quantize-regressions` and will upload plots to the PR.

maya: small note — for public metrics (MTEB) we should preserve original metric semantics; add the comparator under our runner implementation only and call out in release notes.

eli: got it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/828 (draft) — changed comparator, added unit that forces tie by rounding, added lightweight KS-check job. Running full MTEB now :hourglass:

ci-bot: PR checks passed (units). Full MTEB run queued: job 7861. Artifacts will appear in ~2h.

zoe: awesome. if the full run still shows weird spikes, we should capture per-query tie counts and include a tie-report in the dashboard so product teams can triage.

eli: will add per-query tie-counts + topk-stability metric to the rerank dashboard. thanks everyone :pray:
